subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. Write the sequence only. 18=8 (a) But water was at the bottom and out of its reach. (b) It flew from one place to another in search of water. (c) As each pebble went down, the water in the jar rose up little by little. (d) A crow was very thirsty and wanted to drink water. (e) It took some pebbles and then it dropped them into the jar. (f) Then it hit upon a plan. (g) At last, it found a jar in a garden. (h) When the water came to the mouth of the jar, the crow drank and quenched its thirst.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
source: SSC English 1st Paper Rajshahi Board-2016 (Test Paper 127-150)
